1: # Tasks: Entry Versioning + Skill Pack Export
2: 
3: > **Chain strategy**: Feature Branch Chain  
4: > **Review budget**: 400 lines per PR

6: > **PR #1 targets**: `feature/versioning-pack`  
7: > **PR #2 targets**: `feature/versioning-pack-entry-versions` (PR #1 branch)

12: ## PR #1: Entry Versioning — Store Layer
13: 
14: **Branch**: `feature/versioning-pack-entry-versions`  
15: **Base**: `feature/versioning-pack`  
16: **Estimated**: ~310 lines  
17: **400-line budget risk**: Low
18: 
19: ### Phase 1: Migration + Domain
20: 
21: - [ ] 1.1 Create migration `006_entry_versions.sql` with `entry_versions` table DDL + schema_migrations insert — `internal/db/migrations/006_entry_versions.sql`
22: - [ ] 1.2 Add `EntryVersion` struct to domain package — `internal/domain/entry.go`
23: 
24: ### Phase 2: Store Interface + Implementation
25: 
26: - [ ] 2.1 Add `EntryVersionStore` interface (`SaveVersion`, `ListVersions`, `GetVersion`) and wire `sqliteEntryVersionStore` — `internal/db/store.go`
27: - [ ] 2.2 Implement `sqliteEntryVersionStore` (SaveVersion, ListVersions, GetVersion) — `internal/db/entry_versions_store.go` (new)
28: - [ ] 2.3 Modify `sqliteEntryStore.Save()` to archive old content before UPSERT when title/summary/body changed — `internal/db/entries_store.go`
29: 
30: ### Phase 3: Schema Sync + Tests
31: 
32: - [ ] 3.1 Update `schema.sql` with `entry_versions` table DDL and index — `internal/db/schema.sql`
33: - [ ] 3.2 Write `entry_versions_store_test.go`: test SaveVersion, ListVersions descending, GetVersion by number, empty list for no versions, version auto-increment — `internal/db/entry_versions_store_test.go` (new)
34: - [ ] 3.3 Extend `entries_store_test.go`: verify Save() archives old content when title/summary/body changes; verify Save() does NOT archive when unchanged — `internal/db/entries_store_test.go`
35: 
36: **Verification**: `go test ./internal/db/...` — all tests pass including migration 006
37:

39: 
40: ## PR #2: Entry Versioning — App + CLI + MCP
41: 
42: **Branch**: `feature/versioning-pack-entry-versions-cli-mcp`  
43: **Base**: `feature/versioning-pack-entry-versions`  
44: **Depends on**: PR #1  
45: **Estimated**: ~380 lines  
46: **400-line budget risk**: Medium
47: 
48: ### Phase 4: App Service
49: 
50: - [x] 4.1 Implement `EntryVersionService` with `ListVersions` and `RestoreVersion`. `RestoreVersion` retrieves version content, gets current entry, calls `SaveEntry` with restored fields (the `Save()` call auto-archives pre-restore state) — `internal/app/entry_versions.go` (new)
51: - [x] 4.2 Write `entry_versions_test.go`: test ListVersions returns versions in descending order; test RestoreVersion creates new version with pre-restore content; test restore of nonexistent version returns error — `internal/app/entry_versions_test.go` (new)
52: 
53: ### Phase 5: CLI
54: 
55: - [x] 5.1 Extend `ParseCommand` in `entry` subcommand block: add `history` (requires entry ID, returns `"entry-history"`) and `restore` (requires entry ID, parses `--version` flag, returns `"entry-restore"`) — `internal/cli/commands.go`
56: - [x] 5.2 Add `EntryHistoryFlags` and `EntryRestoreFlags` structs with parsing functions (`ParseEntryHistoryFlags`, `ParseEntryRestoreFlags`). `EntryRestoreFlags` accepts `--version` (int, required) — `internal/cli/commands.go`
57: - [x] 5.3 Add `entry-history` and `entry-restore` cases to `runCLI` dispatch: history prints table (version_number, title, saved_at); restore prints restored version and new version created — `cmd/skillvault/main.go`
58: 
59: ### Phase 6: MCP Tools
60: 
61: - [x] 6.1 Register `list_entry_versions` (input: `entry_id` string) and `restore_entry_version` (input: `entry_id` string, `version` number) tools in `registerV2Tools` — `internal/mcp/tools.go`
62: - [x] 6.2 Add dispatch cases for `list_entry_versions` and `restore_entry_version` in `ToolRegistry.dispatch` — `internal/mcp/tools.go`
63: - [x] 6.3 Implement `handleListEntryVersions` and `handleRestoreEntryVersion` handlers. `list_entry_versions` outputs JSON array of versions. `restore_entry_version` returns restored entry with metadata — `internal/mcp/tools.go`
64: - [x] 6.4 Extend `mcp_test.go`: test `list_entry_versions` returns correct count; test `restore_entry_version` restores correct content — `internal/mcp/mcp_test.go`
65: 
66: ### Phase 7: Service Wiring
67: 
68: - [x] 7.1 Instantiate `EntryVersionService` in `openVault()` and add to `vaultServices` struct — `cmd/skillvault/main.go`
69: - [x] 7.2 Wire `EntryVersionService` into `ToolRegistry` via `WithEntryVersionService` builder method — `internal/mcp/tools.go`
70: - [x] 7.3 Extend `cli_test.go` for `entry history` and `entry restore` command parsing — `internal/cli/cli_test.go`
71: 
72: **Verification**: `go test ./...` — all tests pass; `skillvault entry history <id>` lists versions; `skillvault entry restore <id> --version 1` restores content
73: 
74: ---
75: 
76: ## PR #3: Skill Pack Export + Import
77: 
78: **Branch**: `feature/versioning-pack-pack-export`  
79: **Base**: `feature/versioning-pack-entry-versions` (can merge independently of PR #2)  
80: **Estimated**: ~350 lines  
81: **400-line budget risk**: Low
82: 
83: ### Phase 8: Domain + App
84: 
85: - [x] 8.1 Add `VaultPackExport` and `PackMetadata` structs — `internal/domain/filters.go`
86: - [x] 8.2 Implement `VaultPackExportService` — wraps `VaultExportService.ExportAll()`, adds `PackMetadata`, marshals to JSON — `internal/app/pack_export.go` (new)
87: - [x] 8.3 Modify `VaultImportService.Import()` to detect pack format (`pack` key) vs bare `VaultExport`. On pack detection: apply prefix to all IDs in `VaultData`; then delegate to `ImportVault` — `internal/app/import_export.go`
88: 
89: ### Phase 9: Prefix Application
90: 
91: - [x] 9.1 Implement `applyPrefix(prefix string, data *VaultData)` — iterates all slices, prepends prefix to every ID field: `Entries[].ID`, `Entries[].ProjectID`, `Entries[].ArtifactID`, `Projects[].ID`, `Artifacts[].ID`, `Artifacts[].ProjectID`, `Artifacts[].SourceEntryID`, `Workflows[].ID`, `WorkflowSteps[].WorkflowID`, `WorkflowSteps[].ID`, `Series[].ID`, `SeriesEntries[].SeriesID`, `SeriesEntries[].EntryID`, `EntryTags[].EntryID`, `EntryLinks[].FromEntryID`, `EntryLinks[].ToEntryID`, `WorkflowRuns[].WorkflowID`, `WorkflowRunSteps[].RunID`, `WorkflowRunSteps[].EntryID` — `internal/app/import_export.go`
92: 
93: ### Phase 10: CLI
94: 
95: - [x] 10.1 Extend `ParseCommand` in `export` path: detect `--pack` flag for pack export mode; extend `entry` subcommand is already handled in PR #2 — `internal/cli/commands.go`
96: - [x] 10.2 Add `ExportPackFlags` struct (`Pack` string, `Author` string, `Version` string, `Description` string, `OutputPath` string) and `ParseExportPackFlags` function — `internal/cli/commands.go`
97: - [x] 10.3 Add `ImportPackFlags` struct (`FilePath` string, `Prefix` string) — extend existing `ImportFlags` — `internal/cli/commands.go`
98: - [x] 10.4 Extend `runCLI` dispatch: `export` case detects `--pack` flag, calls `VaultPackExportService.ExportPack`; `import` case passes `--prefix` to `VaultImportService.Import` — `cmd/skillvault/main.go`
99: 
100: ### Phase 11: Tests
101: 
102: - [x] 11.1 Write `pack_export_test.go`: test pack export round-trip (export then import with prefix, verify IDs have prefix); test bare export still works; test pack detection on import; test empty prefix imports as-is — `internal/app/pack_export_test.go` (new)
103: - [x] 11.2 Extend `cli_test.go`: test `export --pack` and `import --pack --prefix` flag parsing — `internal/cli/cli_test.go`
104: 
105: ### Phase 12: Service Wiring
106: 
107: - [x] 12.1 Instantiate `VaultPackExportService` in `openVault()`, add to `vaultServices` — `cmd/skillvault/main.go`
108: 
109: **Verification**: `go test ./...` — all tests pass; `skillvault export --pack "Test" --author "me" --version "1.0" --output t.svpack` produces valid pack; `skillvault import --pack t.svpack --prefix "p/"` imports with prefix; bare import still works
110:

113: ## Chain Context
114: 
115: ```
116: feature/versioning-pack (tracker, draft, no-merge)
117: ├── feature/versioning-pack-entry-versions (PR #1 — DB + Domain + Store)

119: │   └── feature/versioning-pack-pack-export (PR #3 — Pack Export + Import)
